findings.summary: Type confusion: array-shaped runner_receipts persist through FileSystemStore, are omitted from revision identity, and are still rehydrated into a trusted runnerReceiptChannel. Silent swap of replay authority without a new CAS head.
findings.acceptance_criteria: 1) FileSystemStore.load/commit MUST normalize non-map runner_receipts (arrays included) to {} or fail closed, using the same predicate as cloneRunnerReceipts. 2) computeRevision and rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel MUST share that predicate; rehydrate MUST NOT Object.values an array into issueRunnerReceiptChannel. 3) Committing [schema-valid runner-receipt/v1] onto an empty-bag head MUST fail closed or change computeRevision (non-empty bag hashed). 4) A runtime test MUST show: array bag does not yield a trusted channel unless runner_receipts_digest is in the new head; map persist still retags as today.

findings.summary: rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel no tiene runtime test del fail-closed homogéneo issuer_id+transport; un bag mixto de dos issuers trusted no está cubierto.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Añadir un test en runner-receipt-store.test.js que persista vía commitRunnerReceipts dos records runner-receipt/v1 válidos con issuer_id distintos (node-test y npm-test, mismo transport), llame rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel, y afirme ok:false, reason_code UNTRUSTED_RUNNER_RECEIPT y channel === undefined.

findings.summary: rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel no tiene test del fail-closed cuando runner_receipts está vacío; sin el guard el código lanza o emite un canal vacío.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Añadir un test que llame rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel sobre un AuthorityStore sin runner_receipts (y una variante con identity.issuer_id/transport trusted) y afirme ok:false, reason_code INVALID_RUNNER_RECEIPT y channel === undefined, sin TypeError.

findings.summary: validatePersistedRecord no tiene test del fallo de schema (kind presente, campos requeridos ausentes); el test existente solo cubre divergencia de receipt_id.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Añadir un test que haga commitRunnerReceipts de un objeto con kind runner-receipt/v1 y campos requeridos ausentes, llame rehydrateAndIssueRunnerReceiptChannel, y afirme ok:false, reason_code INVALID_RUNNER_RECEIPT y channel === undefined (sin llegar a emitir canal).

findings.summary: persistRunnerReceipts no cubre el unhappy path del store (commitRunnerReceipts/persistViaCommit ok:false); los tests solo rechazan el canal untrusted antes de escribir.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Añadir un test con canal trusted donde persistRunnerReceipts reciba {ok:false, code:"receipt-kind-mismatch"} o {ok:false, code:"cas-conflict"} del store y afirme persist.ok===false, reason_code/code igual al del store, y load().runner_receipts/revision sin el bag nuevo.

findings.summary: commitRunnerReceipts trata un array como mapa vacío y puede devolver ok:true sin persistir ni fallar cerrado.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Añadir un test que llame commitRunnerReceipts con un array de un runner-receipt/v1 válido y afirme ok:false (no no-op) o, si se documenta el contrato como mapa-only, el reason/code explícito y runner_receipts sin cambios.

findings.summary: findReceiptKindMismatch returns a boolean and encodes two opposite kind checks without a comment.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Rename to a boolean predicate (e.g. hasReceiptKindMismatch) and add a comment that authority.receipts must not contain kind runner-receipt/v1 while every runner_receipts value must be an object with kind runner-receipt/v1 (non-objects also mismatch).

findings.summary: store.computeRevision infers the live runner_receipts bag from arguments.length without documenting the 3-arg vs 4-arg contract.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Comment (or split helpers) that four explicit args hash that bag as-is (null/empty omits runner_receipts_digest) while three args inject the subject's live runnerReceipts so old callers cannot silently drop the fourth revision component.

findings.summary: persistRunnerReceipts remaps store {code} failures into {reason_code, error, code} by repeating the same string, with no comment on the dual envelope.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Comment that AuthorityStore/FileSystemStore fail with code while this helper's public shape is reason_code, and that rewriting only when committed.code is present preserves passthrough of already-shaped helper errors; or extract a named adapter such as normalizeStoreCommitFailure.
